method: NCBI elink bioproject->pubmed + Europe PMC full-text accession search; open-access full texts scanned for accession/deposition sentences

study.study_description: Closely related wild species Aspergillus flavus and its domesticated form Aspergillus oryzae Transcriptome or Gene expression

curated_conditions.medium: PDA (potato dextrose agar) overlaid with sterile porous cellophane
curated_conditions.production_context: natural isolates of A. oryzae (promoter tandem-repeat variation vs expression)
curated_conditions.metadata_source: BioProject PRJNA178638 (SRA study SRP016952, Vanderbilt University), article 'Assessing the genome-wide effect of promoter region tandem repeat natural variation on gene expression' (G3 2012, doi 10.1534/g3.112.004663, PMC3516485; data statement 'SRX202391 - SRX202398 (A. oryzae RNAseq)', which are this BioProject's A. oryzae experiments; the BioProject abstract is the paper's abstract): 500 uL of a conidial suspension (10^7/mL) spread on potato dextrose agar covered with sterile porous cellophane and grown at 30 C for 24 h; mycelium scraped, TRIzol RNA, TruSeq poly-A libraries on Illumina HiSeq 2000. Isolate RIB302 (SRX202394, BioSample SAMN01797907). One library per isolate.
